name: Sub Nav
description: A secondary horizontal nav row with an underline indicator for the active item that scrolls when items overflow.
usage:
<SubNav aria-label="Project settings">
  <SubNavItem active href="#general">General</SubNavItem>
  <SubNavItem href="#members">Members</SubNavItem>
  <SubNavItem href="#billing">Billing</SubNavItem>
</SubNav>

anatomy.description: Secondary landmark row under the header, named by aria-label.
Real links; the active one sets aria-current="page".
Primary indicator on the active item, aligned with the row's bottom border.

dos: Use it for a second level of navigation below the primary nav.
Let long rows scroll horizontally rather than wrap.
donts: Don't use it to switch panels of content; use Tabs for tab semantics.
Don't stack several sub-navs; one secondary level is enough.

examples.title: Section navigation
examples.description: A row of page-level links under the header; the active item keeps a primary underline.

examples.title: Scrollable overflow
examples.description: Long rows scroll horizontally instead of wrapping, so narrow containers keep one line.

guidance.useWhen: A section of the app needs its own second level of navigation below the primary nav, such as settings or project pages.
guidance.avoidWhen: Items switch panels of content rather than navigate; use Tabs instead so keyboard and aria semantics match.
guidance.behavior: Items are real links; the active item exposes aria-current="page" and a persistent underline that aligns with the row's bottom border.
guidance.responsive: The row scrolls horizontally when items exceed the available width; labels never wrap.

keyboard.action: Moves focus between items, wrapping at the ends.
Moves focus to the first or last item.

notes: Renders a navigation landmark with a configurable aria-label.
The active item is announced as the current page through aria-current="page".

props.description: Accessible name for the navigation landmark.
props.name: aria-label

props.description: Marks the item as the current page; sets `aria-current="page"` and shows the underline.
props.name: active
